Behind the image
83 / Bow Ruffle
REFERENCE 5959.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 059
Art direction: Navy and pale blue on a soft grey backdrop, collegiate romance, clean full-length
framing and even studio light.
Photorealistic full-length vertical fashion lookbook photograph of an original adult woman with
long, light-brown hair falling past her shoulders, silver hoop earrings, pale blue-grey eyes and a
calm, neutral gaze. She wears a navy textured long-sleeve mini dress with a pale blue Peter Pan
collar and cuffs, a bodice of vertical ruffled panels tied at the center with a dark self-tie bow, a
fitted waist and a ruffled wave hem. Dark knee-high socks with a lighter grey cuff, chunky brown
leather loafers with squared toes, and a slim brown leather shoulder bag with gold hardware. Pale
grey seamless studio background, soft even light, navy and pale blue palette, collegiate romantic
styling, no text or logos.
